commit.message:
fix(clang-tidy): initialize placement-new storage in registry macro (#1292)

Value-initializes the placement-new `storage` array in
`registry_bridge_macro.h`, fixing the 6 remaining
`cppcoreguidelines-pro-type-member-init` alerts (all expanded from this
macro in `bigdata_com_api_gen.cpp` and `vehicle_gen.cpp`). The array is
immediately overwritten by placement new, so behavior is unchanged.
